claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested on the steamboat Belle Ida and taken to the Central police station on November 1, 1870.
claims.excerpt: Allen got up promptly and went with the officer.

claims.statement: Daniel B. Stephens petitioned for a writ of habeas corpus, saying Tom Allen was held illegally in the calaboose with no charge against him.
claims.excerpt: Thos. Alen, in the calaboose, in St. Louis county

claims.statement: The habeas corpus petition for Tom Allen was presented to Judge Stewart of the court of criminal correction.
claims.excerpt: which was presented to Mr. Stewart, prov judge of the court of crimi-

claims.statement: A writ of attachment was ordered against Chief of Police James McDonough for contempt of court in not producing Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: writ of attachment was ordered against the chief

claims.statement: Chief James McDonough surrendered Tom Allen to the court, which discharged him; no charges were made against Allen.
claims.excerpt: The chief surrenders the party into the custody of the court 41d prefers no charges against him.

claims.statement: Police arrested Tom Allen and Gallagher to break off their prize fight on November 1, 1870.
claims.excerpt: the arrests of Allen and Gallagher was not so much to have the pugilists punished as to break off the tight.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he could not claim the stakes and did not want to, and that the fight would come off that day.
claims.excerpt: He stated that he culd not claim the stakes and did not want to, and that the fight wou'd come off to day.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Tom Kelly said the fight would not take place, since the agreement did not forfeit the stakes on magisterial interference.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, and also Tom Kelly, assert that the fight will not take place, as there was a clause in the

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was never better and weighed 180 pounds when stripped (printed as 180 wounds).
claims.excerpt: Thomas stated that he was never better in his hfe, weighed 180 wounds when stripped

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Why didn't these men come and tell me their man (Gallagher) was sick? Had they told me, it would have saved all this trouble.
quotes.topic: Gallagher's backers should have said he was sick

fights.place: Foster's Island, 23 miles from the city
fights.excerpt: the arrests of Allen and Gallagher was not so much to have the pugilists punished as to break off the tight.
fights.notes: Stopped by the police arrests; Allen and Kelly said it would not take place, and the stakes were not forfeited under the articles. Place is the planned one given by Gallagher.

notes: Hint's weight (186 pounds) and other personal details are not in the text; the text prints 180 wounds. The Gallagher arrest and the wife-notification hint is not clearly supported and is left out.
